content:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: detected suspicious auth+put activity to private log bucket (s3://redwood-priv-logs). Possible leaked debug logs. Auto-escalating to incidents channel.

Oncall Pager: ack — I'm on. what's the current impact?

Alice M: root cause hypothesis: misconfigured log forwarder started sending debug-level payloads from staging/edge into the private bucket. CloudTrail shows ~4.8k PutObject events from 3 external IPs over the last 2h. Sample object keys: 
`priv/edge/2026-03-18/worker-5342/debug-conn-abc.log`

Ben K: confirm. I see the same in the S3 access logs. Also seeing repeated signed-url generation by the forwarder service role. Likely compromised service credentials or a runaway config.

Carol S: initial triage: contents appear to include header lines with session ids and some user-agent strings; might contain token fragments. We need to assume customer PII/credentials could be in those lines.

SecOps: recommended immediate actions: block forwarder writes, rotate the IAM credentials for the forwarder, create a forensic copy of exposed objects, and rekey the KMS CMK used by the bucket. Also add temporary WAF/IP blocks for the three suspicious IPs.

Ben K: agreed. Proposed mitigation runbook: 
1) disable forwarder IAM role (remove sts:AssumeRole) 
2) rotate access keys / create new role with limited write scope 
3) lock down bucket policy to VPC endpoint only 
4) copy exposed objects to secure forensics bucket and then scrub originals (redact session-id lines) 
5) notify Legal + CS; prepare customer notif template if threshold met

Oncall Pager: who takes owner on 1-3 vs 4-5?

Ben K: I'll own 1-3 (rotation + policy) — starting now.

Carol S: I'll own 4 (forensics copy + scrub). Will preserve originals read-only in a sealed forensics bucket for now.

Alice M: I'll draft customer comms and coordinate with CS/Legal.

Ben K: running commands now: 
```bash
# disable assume-role temporarily
aws iam update-assume-role-policy --role-name redwood-log-forwarder-role --policy-document '{}'
# rotate keys (create new role + update agent config)
# copy exposed objects for forensics
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-priv-logs/priv/edge/2026-03-18/ s3://redwood-forensics/priv/edge/2026-03-18/ --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*.log'
```

Carol S: started copy job. snapshotting metadata first. preserving object integrity with checksum export. ETA copy: ~20m. After copy I'll run scrub script to redact session-id lines from live bucket.

SecOps: I'll spin up a new CMK and schedule re-encryption. Also pushing WAF rules now: blocking 3 IPs at edge. Added temporary ACL on bucket to disallow public puts.

Legal: please preserve chain of custody for the forensics bucket and notify me when we have the object list + samples. We'll evaluate notification obligations. Keep template muted until we confirm scope.

Alice M: quick impact estimate: based on routing config, ~12 tenants have debug-level routing into that forwarder. We'll need to confirm which of their logs contained header lines with session ids. Carol, can you produce a list of object prefixes by tenant?

Carol S: yes — copying will retain prefixes; I'll produce a CSV mapping key -> tenant tag within 30m.

Ben K: rotation update: forwarder assume-role disabled, new role created with restricted write to `s3://redwood-priv-logs/ingest/` only, agent restarted to use new role. Old keys revoked. Pushing monitoring rule to alert on further PutObject anomalies.

Oncall Pager: great. any sign of continued exfil after block?

Ben K: no new suspicious PutObject events since we disabled the role and blocked IPs (monitoring window 2m).

Carol S: copy finished. moved originals to `s3://redwood-forensics/XXXX` (sealed, read-only). Starting scrub on live bucket: redacting lines matching regex `session_id|Authorization` and replacing with `[REDACTED]`.

Alice M: Customer comms draft: short notice describing potential exposure of debug logs, what we did (rotate keys, blocked traffic, preserved evidence), and next steps (detailed follow-up after forensic review). Will attach impact CSV once Carol shares.

Legal: we need the exact tenant list + time window before outbound notification. If PII or credentials exposed, we escalate to notifiable incident. Good work on quick containment.

SecOps: created ticket INC-2198765432 with runbook and artifacts link. Severity set to P2 for now, moving to P1 if we confirm token/credential exfil.

Ben K: monitoring: added temporary CloudWatch rule to detect PutObject counts > 50/min for this bucket; alerting to secops + oncall.

Carol S: scrub complete for live bucket (replaced matched lines). Forensics bucket sealed and access restricted to secops+legal. Uploaded CSV map: `s3://redwood-forensics/2198765432/object-tenant-map.csv`

Alice M: sent initial customer notice to CS template queue (private). Legal - will you review before we send?

Legal: reviewing now. expected response within 40m.

Oncall Pager: next steps: monitor for 1h, await Legal decision, prepare postmortem once incident closed. Keep channel open.

Ben K: confirmed rotation + blocks in place. will keep active watch for next 60m.

Carol S: forensics evidence stored, scrub logs replaced in-live. All tasks from initial runbook marked in ticket.

Oncall Pager: thanks team. closing active bridge but keeping channel pinned for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2198765432 updated: status=contained, participants logged, artifacts attached.
